name: UI Patterns Field Group
description: Integrates UI Patterns with Field Group, letting field groups render as UI Patterns components.
project_description:
This module integrates UI Patterns with Field Group .

 In UI Patterns 1.x, this features are part of an UI Patterns sub-module.

In UI Patterns 2.x, this will live in its own module so this is a temporary placeholder.

 Patch needed on Field Group for 2.x to work 
 "drupal/field_group": {

 "[#3495221] Add $form and $form_state parameters to formatter plugins' settingsForm method": "https://www.drupal.org/files/issues/2024-12-20/3495221-4.patch"

 },
